script: Britain sent commandos on a secret mission to kill Rommel, the general the whole Allied army feared most. In 1941, a small team landed by submarine on the coast of Libya at night, moving inland under total secrecy. Their target was Rommel's own headquarters, hundreds of miles behind enemy lines. They stormed the building in the dark, room by room, guns raised, expecting to find the general asleep inside. But Rommel was not there that night, he had left days earlier without anyone in Britain knowing. The raid collapsed into chaos, and most of the commandos never made it back to the coast alive. The mission stayed classified for years, quietly filed away as a failure nobody wanted to explain. Britain sent commandos to kill Rommel, and came within one night of changing the war.
